name: SBEC Systems (India) Ltd.
summary: SBEC Systems (India) Ltd. specializes in providing engineering and associated technical consulting services. The firm offers a comprehensive portfolio spanning scientific, technical, engineering, professional, and commercial solutions. Its activities include the design, planning, and detailed specification of various contracts, assignments, and specific projects. Additionally, the company undertakes the fabrication, erection, and commissioning of projects, and supplies sophisticated equipment to the sugar and power sectors. Established on December 15, 1987, its corporate headquarters are located in New Delhi, India.
